name: claude-plugins
description: Workflow plugins for Claude Code — adversarial review loops and engineering standards.

plugins.name: crucible
plugins.description: A crucible does not make the thing; it applies enough heat that only what survives comes out. Splits building from judging across adversarial agents that can each overrule the other, coordinating through a shared board. The brain optionally splits into a left hemisphere judging correctness and a right judging whether a person can actually use the result.
